description: A stereo noise source with a high pass and a low pass filter across it, and a rate control that sets how coarse the noise is.

params.text: How much the FQ jack moves that rate.
How fast new random values are produced, which sets how coarse or how smooth the noise sounds.
Cutoff of the high pass filter.
How much the HIGH jack moves the high pass cutoff.
Cutoff of the low pass filter.
How much the LOW jack moves the low pass cutoff.
Sets the colour of the noise: up is white, middle is pink, down is red.

inputs.text: Moves the low pass cutoff, by as much as the MOD knob beside LOW allows.
Moves the high pass cutoff, by as much as the MOD knob beside HIGH allows.
A trigger that produces one new random value on each rising edge.
Moves the rate new values are produced at, by as much as the MOD knob beside FQ allows.
Sets the output level of the noise.
Sets where the noise is placed across the stereo outputs.

notes: Set Rack's sample rate to 96kHz before using this module. At any other rate it runs at the wrong speed, and a red bar appears across the bottom of the panel saying so.
An unpatched modulation CV jack does not read 0V: the firmware drives it from an internal chaotic generator, so a MOD knob turned up with nothing patched lets a wandering voltage through.
